title: If you want to make a lot of tea it's great, but other wise water doesn't get into filter
text: If you want to make a lot of tea it's great, but other wise water doesn't get into filter. Kettle is heat resistant and easy to clean, but in order to get water into filter you have to fill Kettle at least half way up and that's a lot of dried tea leaves. I guess if you want to make a whole Kettle it would work, but I only want enough to make 1 or to cups of hot tea.
